parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, providing support and housing for shelves and doors.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure, holds the shelves, and provides stability for the door and stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that remains stationary while other parts like doors may move.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges and equipped with a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet and protects the contents from dust and external exposure.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close, providing controlled access to the cabinet interior.
